name: Green Glades Farm
tagline: Green Glades Farm map and directions
description: Green Glades Farm is a family-run pumpkin patch in 336 Glades Road, GA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
